'''Jurnak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Jurnak was stationed in a Imperial laboratory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he and his colleagues studied the salvage that Imperial soldiers recovered from the crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]]; one of note was the [[regenerative armor]], which restored life of individuals on the verge of the death. The Empire gave the armor to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]] to use in his attacks on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jurnak was later captured by the [[Rift Alliance]] and defected to the Republic in exchange for information.
